protocol.scope: Deterministic information and finite-family window optimization plus coefficient-preserving replay of the completed heterogeneous protocol

vdp_information.scope: Local covariance bound for regular locally unbiased estimation of four independently free active coefficients with fixed known covariance; not a bound on median errors or biased sparse discovery.

scope: All numerical experiments execute on Kaggle. Replay adds coefficient preservation, not independent evidence. Information and empirical RMSE are comparable scales, not proof of efficiency of biased estimators.
